name: dsh-workbench
description: Workbench for DeepSeek Harness: DSH as a project layer. One canvas per project chains methods into loops (input → exec & log → task output); only exec methods run and only a passing verifier plus an artifact on disk turns a node green; one memory JSON truth per project regenerates the project's AGENTS.md block; roles bind models per project (t1 judge / t2 refine / t3 batch). Host API is 8 routes behind one snapshot; wb_get/wb_set/wb_close stay agent-side.
